interface.simultaneous_read_write: Outside the proposed restricted contract; the supplied model supports write-through, which must not be confused with write-holds-Q.

digital_obligation.clock: posedge A_CLK; observe Q after the modeled edge update
digital_obligation.read: At enabled non-write edge, Q becomes contents[A_ADDR]; contents unchanged.
digital_obligation.write: At enabled full-mask write with REN=0, contents[A_ADDR] becomes A_DIN; Q holds; other words unchanged.
digital_obligation.idle: With REN=WEN=0, contents and Q hold.
digital_obligation.initialization: Contents and Q arbitrary at power-up; no SRAM reset-clear assumption. Readiness/coverage must establish all observed words.
digital_obligation.evidence: Pinned behavioral core and macro documentation; existing hybrid array proofs and paired simulation/binding checks are distinct evidence.
